text:
Partly, and only as a reference layer. The JRC GFC2020 V4 map doesn't record loss itself; it is a forest/non-forest snapshot for 2020. Here it agrees (fraction 1.0) that the area where loss was detected was forest in 2020.

The 2023 loss itself comes from Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change: about 0.7 ha (1.2% of the 58.1 ha asset). A later year (up to 2025) was observed, and together with the JRC agreement that corroborates the loss under the method.

Context: the MGAP 2021 map shows 0.4 ha of this as planted forest (Eucalyptus), 0.3 ha outside mapped forest, and none as native forest. Another 0.4 ha of smaller patches (under 0.5 ha) was not counted as an event.

Limits: this doesn't establish deforestation (cutting a plantation counts as loss), the cause, legality, responsibility, or any compliance status.
